description: Use this when you, the buyer, chose a public service and want its delivery checked end to end. Pass `service_url`, `checks` and explicit_read_only_consent=true. GAIP preflights it and records your checks; returns a `terms_id` for assurance_complete. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

counterparty_id.description: Name or URL of the agent or service.

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

episode_id.description: Optional: your own id to group related calls.

explicit_read_only_consent.description: Must be true: you consent to a public, read-only check.

service_url.description: Public https URL of the service.

task_class.description: Optional: short name of the task, e.g. weather_forecast.

name: assurance_prepare
title: Prepare a buyer-side delivery check
